sql: WITH FamilyCounts AS (SELECT family, COUNT(posting_key) AS open_remote_us_listings FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing GROUP BY family) SELECT family, open_remote_us_listings, SUM(open_remote_us_listings) OVER (ORDER BY open_remote_us_listings DESC) AS running_total FROM FamilyCounts ORDER BY open_remote_us_listings DESC
